<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/history/device-point-values/query"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



This API is used to query the change history of multiple traits for multiple devices within a given time range. It supports continuous retrieval of historical records through the pagination cursor `cursor`.

To query the latest changes, omit `cursor` to start a new query. Do not reuse a pagination cursor for polling.

You may adjust `pageSize` when querying the next page with the most recently returned `nextCursor`. Only an identical retry of the latest continuation request is supported; `cursor`, `pageSize`, and all other query parameters must remain unchanged. After advancing, reading from an earlier `cursor` is not supported.

Invalid parameters or an invalid `cursor` result in a `400` response. If the cursor expires or becomes invalid, omit `cursor` and start a new query; the query does not automatically resume from the beginning. A `503` response indicates that the query service is temporarily busy and may be retried.
